text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel tore through the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) with every ounce of strength she 
had. Her fears and worries about her legs 
were now things of the past.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her only regret was not being able to 
compete against Narita Brian. That 
idolized figure grew ever larger within 
Sakura Laurel's heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is bound to make a swift 
comeback. Believing this, Sakura Laurel 
puts even more passion into her training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There was no telling when their showdown 
would happen. That was precisely why they 
prepared with the Tenno Sho (Autumn) as 
their target, so they would be ready to 
face them anytime.
